question: What power arises from always contemplating a smoke-colored form?
premises: A smoke-colored form is to be contemplated always
The practitioner gains power over the triple world
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
uncertainties: the object contemplated as smoke-colored is not explicitly named
plain_english: O beloved, always contemplate what is smoke-colored, and one can shake the triple world.
